scope: Every alpha>=128 texel on final independent labels. The5MP badge instead follows native CAD face geometry and is checked by loader UV/material tests. Gaps are retained/reported; zero penetration does not certify physical label support.

results.label: rear-paper
results.method: Every source-texture pixel with alpha>=128 is checked at its center against assembled physical triangles transformed into label coordinates. Barycentric orthographic ray/surface intersection; max local-Z gives nearest outward support, without a one-sided-normal assumption. No textured label, UNKNOWN text, live framebuffer or invisible input plane supplies support.
